fields.name: Retry backoff
fields.definition: How long the resilience strategy waits before each retry of a transient error. The wait is computed from `RetryInterval` (milliseconds) and the `RetryLengthening` sequence, which is one of Linear (1, 2, 3, 4… × interval), Lengthening (1, 3, 5, 7… × interval), HalfSquare or Squaring and defaults to Lengthening. `Fibonacci` is an obsolete alias of Lengthening kept so existing configuration still binds; the progression was never a Fibonacci sequence. `RetryCount` caps the number of retries. All three settings participate in the configuration hierarchy and fall back to built-in defaults when unset.
